verdict.rationale: Cloudflare markets billing as CPU-time-only and 'no wall time' even for long agent workflows and hibernating WebSockets (cloudflare-docs-15, cloudflare-docs-32), and ships Workflows for durable multi-day persistence (cloudflare-docs-27/41), but hands-on community reporting explicitly states the real caps — '30s CPU time on the free tier and even the 15min on paid plans don't work for long-running agent tasks' (cloudflare-comm-9) — directly contradicting the implication that agentic workloads simply fit. The evidence pack contains no first-party page in this pack that states the concrete CPU/wall-clock numbers for a devops-lead to plan against; missing for 10: an official Workers limits/pricing doc citing exact CPU-ms and wall-clock timeouts per plan, and reconciliation of that with the community-reported 30s/15min caps.
